name: Lowell Felice De Roderigo
source:
MATURE ROMANCE

The Count whose every move is measured, and whose words carry quite weight. In a moment of crisis, he appeared before Chris what does he truly feel― and will Chris perceive him?

[From [url=https://how-to-grow-a-man.fandom.com/wiki/Lowell_Felice_De_Roderigo]How to Grow a Man Wiki[/url]]
